cases.failure: A blank worksheet is the first useful content.
cases.required_response: Reject and place explanation plus a completed example before any blank template.

cases.failure: A fictional unrun example replaces an available rights-safe finished production.
cases.required_response: Reject and inspect the real production and its permitted public provenance.

cases.failure: A public source name is removed only because the private runtime skill also hides its own name.
cases.required_response: Separate public provenance from private implementation and retain permitted attribution.

cases.failure: The guide is dominated by records, gates, owners, and handoff language.
cases.required_response: Redesign around the reader's job, explanation, action, example, and troubleshooting.

cases.failure: Every topic receives a guide, prompt pack, template pack, and attachment plan by default.
cases.required_response: Require each component to name the reader problem it solves or remove it.

cases.failure: A visual or motion judgment is explained only through prose and arrows.
cases.required_response: Require inspectable visual evidence or label the material reference-only.

cases.failure: The producer marks the guide approved after its own review and a passing validator.
cases.required_response: Reject self-approval and require an independent review plus named human owner.

cases.failure: Specialist terms appear before the reader receives a plain-language definition.
cases.required_response: Define each necessary term at first use and preserve the expert-level detail afterward.

cases.failure: A copy-ready prompt appears without when to use it, inputs, limits, or judgment criteria.
cases.required_response: Add the human context around the prompt or remove it.

cases.failure: The prose passes writing cleanup but a cold reader cannot complete the first action.
cases.required_response: Reject the guide because prose hygiene is not teaching acceptance.
